components.html:
Nandini's Physio Sanctuary

An illuminated wrist restoration portal with multi-week progression criteria.
components.css: .ds-chronicle-card { background: #242c26; border: 1px solid #2e3831; border-radius: 4px; padding: 18px 20px; color: #ede4d1; font-family: 'Spectral', Georgia, serif; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; color: #dfba6d; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; color: #ede4d1; }

narrative.overview: A high-fantasy, Middle-earth-inspired visual system built on the physical aesthetics of illuminated manuscripts, ancient tomes, and elven craft.
keyCharacteristics: Zero gradients: solid earth pigments, authentic gold leaf inlays
Celtic & Gondorian filigree corner knots and White Tree heraldry
High-contrast serif typography pairing Cinzel with Spectral

rules.name: The Zero-Gradient Doctrine
rules.body: No linear, radial, or conic gradients may ever appear. Contrast and atmosphere are achieved through physical pigment hierarchy and solid gold leaf inlays.

dos: Do maintain strict zero-gradient solid pigments on all elements
Do frame interactive views with high-craft elven/dwarven heraldry and filigree
Do ensure all text maintains at least 4.5:1 contrast against dark slate grounds
donts: Don't use generic modern web gradients, glows, or pill badges
Don't allow the desktop hero layout to overflow or create page scrollbars
